title: legal-binder-tools: Bates numbering, exhibit labels, index tab cut math and binder ring sizing (Tabzoola)
description: Dependency-free JavaScript helpers for legal and office binders, published by Tabzoola (tabzoola.com), the custom index tab dividers maker in Schaumburg, Illinois, run by Anselmo Die & Index. Includes Bates number ranges, exhibit labels and exhibit lists (numbers, letters, Roman numerals), index tab cut and position math, and 3-ring binder capacity sizing. The same logic runs the free tools at https://tabzoola.com.
